company_name: JIANN SHENG MACHINERY & ELECTRIC INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD.
semiconductor_relevance: High — JIANN SHENG MACHINERY & ELECTRIC INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD. specializes in precision cutting technologies for semiconductor materials, particularly in the slicing of SiC and other hard-brittle materials.
summary: JIANN SHENG MACHINERY & ELECTRIC INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD. (JSEDM) provides advanced cutting solutions for semiconductor materials, focusing on high-precision Wire EDM systems and Diamond Wire Saws. Their technologies are designed to optimize the slicing of both conductive and non-conductive materials, enhancing material utilization and processing efficiency.
capabilities: Wire EDM systems for high-precision machining
Diamond Wire Saw for slicing SiC and other hard-brittle materials
12-inch Diamond Wire Saw for large-diameter single-crystal SiC processing
